body:
Geometric walltime reporting was removed in #2026, but some find it useful for debugging, so I've added it back in here in the form of a config flag: 

- **`walltime_debug::Bool`** (default `false`) — also report the walltime on power-of-two steps, on top of the `walltime_dt` interval. If `walltime_dt` is `"never"`, those steps become the only reporting.

To accomplish this, I've added two new schedules to `TimeManager`:

- **`PowerOfTwoSchedule`** — true on coupling steps 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, …
- **`OrSchedule(schedules...)`** — true when any child schedule is true.

`maybe_trigger_callback` now passes `(; t, step)`, where `step` is a new field in `CoupledSimulation`. Note: `step` restarts to 0 after a restart, so just counts the number of steps in the *current* run.

All coupler schedules now live in `TimeManager` and subtype `ClimaDiagnostics.Schedules.AbstractSchedule` so that they can be used for diagnostics (and could in principle be moved to `ClimaDiagnostics`/`ClimaUtilities` someday).

All CI, nightly, and longrun configs now have `walltime_debug: true`.

(I also noticed that two `Input.jl` help strings were wrong, so I fixed those).
title: Walltime reporting for debugging
